answer: Resist Sybils with rotating haven berths: each identity may hold only one scarce berth at a wharf, assigned randomly each epoch, and must re-anchor it at dawn by solving a fresh task tied to that berth's cargo. A berth idle for one epoch is reclaimed for a waiting newcomer, so hoarded clones decay instead of accumulating. Because berths are fewer than applicants and each dawn check demands a different job, one operator cannot keep dozens of fakes moored at once: every clone needs its own berth, task, and attention, making mass fakery costly and visible.
